make.name: Leapmotor
make.description: Hangzhou-based EV maker founded in 2015 by Dahua Technology's founders. Stellantis bought about 20% in 2023 (18.99% after FAW took 5% in December 2025) and runs Leapmotor International (51/49), which sells the T03, C10, B10, B05 and B03X in Europe, the UK and Australia.

logo.license: Trademark of Leapmotor; used to identify the brand

models.name: S01
models.description: Leapmotor's first production car, a small electric coupe sold in China from 2019 until it was discontinued in 2021.

generations.name: First generation
generations.description: Leapmotor's first car, a small electric sports coupe.

models.name: T03
models.description: Small electric city car launched in China in 2020 and Leapmotor's first export model, sold in Europe through Stellantis' Leapmotor International since 2024. European assembly in Poland ran from June 2024 to March 2025; the car continues as an import.

generations.name: First generation
generations.description: Small five-door city car launched in May 2020; assembled for Europe at Stellantis' Tychy plant in Poland from June 2024 to March 2025.

models.name: C11
models.description: Mid-size electric SUV launched in China in 2021 and Leapmotor's best-selling larger car, also offered as a range-extender. A 2025 facelift moved the BEV to an 800 V platform with 640 km CLTC range.

generations.name: First generation
generations.description: Mid-size SUV revealed at Auto Guangzhou 2020, on sale from September 2021; a range-extender version (not listed) arrived for 2023.

generations.name: 2026 model-year facelift
generations.description: Facelift announced July 2025 with a lower nose, 800 V electrics and an 81.9 kWh LFP pack.

models.name: C01
models.description: Mid-size to large electric sedan sold in China since 2022, with LFP rear-drive and NMC all-wheel-drive versions plus a range-extender.

generations.name: First generation
generations.description: Large electric sedan launched in 2022, also offered as a range-extender.

models.name: C10
models.description: Mid-size electric SUV launched in 2024, Leapmotor's first global model, sold in Europe, the UK and Australia through Leapmotor International as a BEV and a range-extender.

generations.name: First generation
generations.description: Mid-size SUV shown at Munich 2023, launched in China in March 2024 and in Europe in September 2024 (also as a range-extender); facelifted in June 2026.

models.name: C16
models.description: Three-row full-size SUV launched in China in 2024 with battery-electric and range-extender versions; planned for Australia.

generations.name: First generation
generations.description: Six-seat full-size SUV launched in 2024 as a BEV and range-extender; facelifted on 16 June 2026.

models.name: B10
models.description: Compact electric SUV launched in 2025, the first car on the LEAP 3.5 platform, sold in China, Europe (assembled in Zaragoza, Spain), Australia and Asia. Five stars in Euro NCAP and ANCAP.

generations.name: First generation
generations.description: Compact SUV launched in April 2025, built in China, Spain (Zaragoza), Indonesia and Malaysia; updated in July 2026 for the 2027 model year.

models.name: B01
models.description: Compact electric sedan launched in China in 2025 on the LEAP 3.5 platform shared with the B10.

generations.name: First generation
generations.description: Compact sedan on sale from July 2025; refreshed in July 2026 with 800 V-class electronics on the larger packs.

models.name: Lafa 5
models.description: Rear-drive electric compact hatchback launched in China in September 2025 as the Lafa 5 and exported as the Leapmotor B05 to Europe, the UK and Australia from 2026.

generations.name: First generation
generations.description: Rear-drive compact hatchback launched in China in September 2025; Europe from April 2026, the UK and Australia from July 2026.

models.name: A10
models.description: Subcompact electric SUV launched in China in March 2026 and sold in Europe as the Leapmotor B03X.

generations.name: First generation
generations.description: Small SUV on sale in China from March 2026; the export B03X has more power (130-145 kW vs 70-90 kW in China).

models.name: A05
models.description: Subcompact electric hatchback that debuted in China on 20 July 2026, to be sold abroad as the Leapmotor B03.

generations.name: First generation
generations.description: Subcompact front-drive hatchback revealed in July 2026; Spanish production planned from 2027.

models.name: D19
models.description: Leapmotor's flagship full-size SUV, launched in April 2026; the EV has three motors and a 115 kWh dual-chemistry CATL pack.

generations.name: First generation
generations.description: Flagship full-size SUV revealed in October 2025 and launched in April 2026 with BEV and range-extender versions.

models.name: D99
models.description: Full-size flagship MPV revealed at Leapmotor's 10th-anniversary event in December 2025, with a 115 kWh CATL pack in the EV version.

generations.name: First generation
generations.description: Flagship MPV revealed in December 2025 on a 1000 V architecture, with BEV and range-extender versions.
